tool_signatures.name: rig_audit
tool_signatures.description: Read-only Moho Pro 14.4 Rig Health Linter: checks for non-zero strength on Pin Bones / IK Targets / Smart Bone dials, rigid-bound GroupLayers trapping bone-bound children, Animated Layer Order collisions across multiple Smart Bone Actions, BoneLayers stuck in an active Action, unbound artwork under BoneLayers, and missing pre-roll for active Bone Dynamics or ParticleLayers.

tool_signatures.name: rig_auditGltf

tool_signatures.name: rig_getControls
